summary.subject: Spans: every node ends where its last token does (End, with EndPosition on Node), and the names a reader points at have positions of their own: a function's or type's name and owner, a field after the dot, each part of a type path, an import's path string and an alias, the kind after is, a markup element's name and end tag and a fragment's; tokens, template parts, comments, and markup nodes and attributes carry EndPos from the lexer; ast.Start is where a chain or an operator begins on the page, Contains and Path find the nodes at a position, Inspect walks a tree in source order visiting the parts with positions too; Bad nodes are declared for the recovering parser to come; a corpus test checks each span lies in its parent's and each name position holds the name
